{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = df.isnull().sum()

# Check value counts for key categorical variables
arm_counts = df['arm'].value_counts()
responded_counts = df['responded'].value_counts()

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_biomarker = df['biomarker_baseline'].isin([-999.0, -999, -999.00]).sum()

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = df.duplicated().sum()

# Print findings
print("Missing values:")
print(missing_values)
print("\nArm counts:")
print(arm_counts)
print("\nResponded counts:")
print(responded_counts)
print("\nSentinel values in biomarker_baseline (should be -999.0):")
print(sentinel_biomarker)
print("\nDuplicate rows:")
print(duplicates)"}
